title: Empty Parking Lot Waltz
summary: Last two people in a vast wet lot. They could go or they could stay. The last chord never arrives.
visualArc: Two cars → rumpled dress on a door → orbit without touching → unresolved.

segments.label: Last cars out
segments.onScreen: Two cars in a massive wet lot at 1am. Streetlight grid in puddles.
segments.lyrics: We could go / or we could stay
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Cinematic wide still of a vast empty wet parking lot at 1am, only two cars left, their headlights the only lights, a woman in a rumpled evening dress leaning against a car door, reflections of streetlights in puddles forming a grid of stars, photoreal, 35mm, Grok Imagine style
segments.geminiOmniPrompt: 20-second slow orbit around two figures who almost dance without touching. Photoreal.
